newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine bonds slightly up, seen rangebound.
newsitem.headline: Argentine bonds slightly up, seen rangebound.

text.p: Argentine bonds were slightly higher late morning Thursday amid trader-dominated activity, with prices seen rangebound until the policy setting meeting of the U.S. Federal Open Market Committee May 20.
"There is basically sideways trade with mainly dealers playing around," said a trader at a local bank. "There is no genuine trend here."
Argentina's FRB Brady bond due 2005 was up 1/8 at 92-1/4, while the dollar-denominated Bocon Previsional 4 due 2002 was up $0.05 at 115.15.
Another trader predicted "more nervousness ahead of the FOMC," as players remain divided on the likely outcome and on the market's reaction to a possible rate hike.
